content: # **📝 List of Contents** 📍CLO-SET [Visual Board](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303200610841) provides a blank canvas to make presentations with your 3D assets. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777927326233) 1. Enter Visual Board 2. Create & Edit 3. Upload Content(s) 4. Invite Editors 5. Slide Show Mde # **📓 Details** **1\. Enter Visual Board** --- * Log in to CLO-SET and Click 'Visual Board' at the bottom of the 'Workspace' menu. * A new Visual Board page will open. Click on the '+' button to create a new Board. * If you are invited to an existing Board, please check the Group Name at the top. You can enter different Groups by clicking on the downward arrow (⌄) next to the Group name at the top left. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777952087193) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/58773017825945) **2\. Create & Edit **[(view full tutorial)](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303200610841) --- * Before getting into the action, we recommend creating a test Board to explore the feature. * Type in the title and explanation, and click 'Create'. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777952396953) * Add text, shapes, and drag & drop the Contents to the Board. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/58773033854873) * When inserting a 3D Content, you will be able to select the viewpoint & link to 3D Viewer. * **Add Images** : select a viewpoint to add the image * **Link** : insert a link to the 3D Viewer for the end users to access the 3D Viewer. * When complete, you will see a purple URL icon indicating the attached URL. ![Screenshot 2024-04-04 at 3.44.47 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777952783385) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777913657881) * Find the full list of edit tools and instructions [**HERE**](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303200610841) * Once you are done editing the Board, click the 'Save' button at the top. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/58773033855769) **3\. Upload Content(s)** --- * To attach your 3D design on the Visual Board, you must first upload the file * [Learn how to upload here](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303166737305) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/58773033856793) * Once uploading is complete, use the Space selection modal on the right pane of the Visual Board to locate the uploaded file. | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777914330521) | **=** | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777928921753) ---|---|---|--- **4\. Slide Show Mode** --- **1\. Share & Invite** * Share the Board to invite others to edit the Board * Click the 'Share' button ![share.svg](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777929306393) at the top-right corner to add Board Editors * Type in the email address, and hit enter. Click 'Share' * The recipient will receive an email notification ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/58773017829657) * Note: Unless shared from other Space/Contents, **recipient's access will be limited to the Visual Board only**. Learn how to share [Contents](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303176205081) or [Space](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303184310681) * **Add Editor** (Add Board Editor for collaboration) * Click the 'Share' button ![share.svg](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/61815382733081) at the top-right corner to add Board Editors * Default: Only the Board Creator and Group Admin can edit. * Add new Editors to each Board to grant Edit permission. * [Important]: When you add an external user (not a member of the Group) to the Board as Editor, additional charges will incur to your billing. Group Admin will receive notification. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/61815407050777) * **Share & Publish** (Share the slide show with external users) From Slide Show mode, click 'Share' at the top-right corner and select an access level: Option | Who can access | If not signed in | If signed in without permission ---|---|---|--- **Restricted** | CLO-SET users with permission to this Board | Redirected to login page | Forbidden **Limited** | Anyone with a CLO-SET account | Redirected to login page | Accessible **Public** _(NEW)_ | Anyone with the link — no CLO-SET account required | Accessible | Accessible **2\. Embedded 3D Viewer** When you click a linked 3D asset during Slide Show, the 3D Viewer opens in a modal window within the slideshow — no need to switch tabs. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/61815382737049) * Select a rendering mode at the top of the viewer: * **Quality Priority** (default on first load): best visual fidelity * **Performance Priority** : faster loading and smoother interaction * Your last selection is remembered (saved as a cookie) and applied the next time you open the viewer.

title: AI Visualizer
content: **Objective** Turn the 3D garments in your workspace into photorealistic images with AI Visualizer. Learn how to combine the garment with reference assets, generate images with an AI engine, and refine the results. 1. Add References 2. Select an AI Engine and Describe the Style 3. Generate and Save 4. Refine the Result ## ## **Details** ### 1) AI Visualizer (Beta): Photorealistic Image Generation from the 3D Viewer An **AI Visualizer** button is available in the 3D Viewer on the Content Page. Clicking it opens the AI Visualizer panel, where the garment currently shown in the 3D Viewer is set as the **Base** image. From there, images can be generated in the following steps: #### **Step 1. Add references (optional)** Alongside the Base garment, up to 8 reference assets can be added and combined into the generated image: * From CLO-SET: browse or search your workspace and select 3D assets, such as a jacket or other garments, to style together with the Base garment. * From Local: upload image files (max file size: 20MB), such as photos of shoes, bags, or other reference items that are not available as 3D assets yet. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/61771970297625)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/61771945031705) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/61771945033241) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/61771945033625) #### **Step 2. Select an AI engine and describe the style** * Choose an AI engine for generation: GPT Image or Gemini. * Describe the image you want in the prompt field, or start from the provided style presets such as Street Fashion, Cinematic Scene, Moody, Technicolor, and Runway. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/61771970305049)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/61771970305817) Additional options give more control over the result: * Preserve avatar face: keep the avatar’s face consistent in the generated image. * Aspect ratio: select the output ratio, such as 3:4. #### **Step 3. Generate and save** Click **Generate** to create the image. Results appear in the **Generated** panel, where they can be selected, saved, and downloaded. **Note** : Images generated on a content are visible to the members of the group that content belongs to. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/61771970306969) #### **Step 4. Refine the result (optional)** Generated images can be refined further instead of starting over. Check **Use current image as base** to generate from the image you just created, and set **AI Transformation Strength** to control how much the AI changes it: * Default: a balanced level of transformation. * Preserve Original Structure: keeps the garment and composition close to the source, for finer touch-ups. * Allow Creative Transformation: gives the AI more freedom for a stronger restyle. This allows a result to be developed step by step, keeping what already works and adjusting only the details. This enhancement allows teams to review styles and styling combinations as photorealistic images before a physical sample exists, and to explore looks that would otherwise require a photoshoot. AI Visualizer works alongside the existing **Render** and **mix &match** features, and each answers a different question: Render produces images that stay faithful to the 3D garment exactly as simulated, mix&match styles the 3D assets already in your workspace, and AI Visualizer explores how a style could look on a model, in a scene, and together with items that do not exist as 3D assets yet.
content_description: Transform your 3D garments into stunning photorealistic images using AI Visualizer by combining reference assets, selecting an AI engine, and refining your results effortlessly.

title: Virtual Showroom
content: Start building your Virtual Showroom, in 360°. Publish it online and start inviting your customers online. #### Permission: ![Admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777869516313)Admin, ![Collaborator.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777892182937)Collaborator, ![Editor.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777869731993)Editor [![240422 Help Center \(4\).png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777892596761)](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303177721113) # **Objective** * [**Find a detailed Virtual Showroom Setup Guide**](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/9105135728271) 1. Checklist 2. Virtual Showroom Setup * Create Showroom * Add/Edit Contents - Add / Replace Space Image \- Add Contents \- Content List - Setting (Name & Logo) \- View Constraints 3. Virtual Showroom Live 4. Download Preset Space Image 5. Virtual Showroom Webinar # **Details** ### 1\. Checklist #### 1) Move Contents to Assortment. From **Workroom** , move Contents to Assortment ► From **Assortment** , create Virtual Showroom --- ![Screenshot 2023-08-02 at 5.09.35 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777870076825) | ![Screenshot 2023-08-02 at 6.07.38 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777850032025) * **You can****only****add the 3D Contents located in the Assortment from which the Virtual Showroom is created**. * You can create 1 Virtual Showroom per Assortment #### 2) Prepare the Environment Image (Background of the Showroom) * #### Take a **360° image** or **2D Image** of your physical Showroom. * You may also choose to use CLO-SET preset images. * 360° image file must be less than 8192 * 4096 px, 100mb. File formats can be png, jpg, webp, gif, or hdr. ### 2\. Virtual Showroom Setup #### 1) Create Virtual Showroom ![Screenshot 2023-11-20 at 6.09.43 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777885363097) | * On the Assortment page, click on ![Show](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777900618905) * Enter the name of your Virtual Showroom. * Select Environment Type: * Upload the 360° Space Image. You may also use the default preset image. * Upload a 2D Image * Upload your Logo, and click 'Create' *You can only create 1 Virtual Showroom per Assortment. If 2 or more users create simultaneously, the first version will be saved. ---|--- #### 2) Add/Edit Contents ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/57833600385689) | 1️⃣ Add **Space** Image 2️⃣ Add **Contents** (3D, 2D, Navigation, and Other) 3️⃣ Content List 4️⃣ Settings - Name & Logo 5️⃣ View Constraints ---|--- *You may only add space images of same type (360° or 2D) per your selection at the time of creation. * VR Mode Support (Oculus Rift) The Virtual Showroom supports VR mode, providing an immersive experience for reviewing collections using devices such as Oculus Rift. ##### 1️⃣ Add / Replace Space Image * You may add multiple Space within your Showroom. * Click **'ADD SPACE** ' on the top left, and upload the Space image to create additional Space * Adding Navigation button will allow your users to switch between Spaces * You can also replace the background image of an existing Space while editing your Virtual Showroom. * From the left panel, click '**ADD SPACE'** , select **Select a 360 Image** , and upload a new image. * The existing background image will be replaced with the newly uploaded image. ![Screenshot 2023-09-15 at 2.13.24 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777901244697) | ![Showroom_Navigation.gif](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777886296473) ---|--- * When uploading background images, a progress bar is now displayed, enabling users to continue working while monitoring upload status. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/57389797309337) ##### 2️⃣ Add Contents (Create Mark) 1\. Click '+' at the bottom to add a Content. Adding a Content will create a new Mark. 2\. Drag & Drop the Content to add a Spot on your Showroom 3\. Hover over the spot to view/edit the details | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777894392473) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777871814041) ---|---|--- 4\. Change the Name / Spot Color & Shape, and click 'Save' | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777894736793) | ▶ | Live Showroom View ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/57389825262489) ---|---|---|--- * For 3D Contents, **drag & drop** the one you want to add, and edit the name and Mark type. * You may add a description of the Content to be displayed on the live Virtual Showroom. But, changes made on the 'description' field will NOT be reflected on the Content Page or other Virtual Showrooms. * For 2D and Other Contents, upload the file you want to add. * For Navigation, select the Mark type and select the Space to move to. | **Edit****Mode** | **on****Live****Showroom** ---|---|--- #### ![3D Content.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777902305689) | ![Screenshot 2023-08-09 at 4.35.59 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777902500249) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/57389825263001) ![2D Content.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777873074329) | ![Screenshot 2023-08-09 at 5.08.03 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777903264921) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/57389825264025) #### ![Navigation.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777896676889) | ![Screenshot 2023-08-09 at 5.12.44 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777889088537) | ![Showroom_Navigation.gif](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777886296473) #### ![Other Content.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777889295513) | ![Screenshot 2023-08-09 at 5.19.59 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777904374425) | ![Screenshot 2023-08-09 at 5.22.05 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777889533593) ##### 3️⃣ Content List ![Screenshot 2023-08-09 at 5.28.08 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777904796825) | • Click 'Content List' at the bottom to view all Contents loaded on your Showroom, and to edit or delete it. • To remove the Content, hover over each Marker and click 'DELETE' ---|--- ##### 4️⃣ Settings - Name & Logo * Add your logo image on Settings * Turn on 'Share Live With Link' option to create a 'Share' button on your Live Showroom * Turn on the “Add to Selection” and “Send Email” options to allow users to select items and send email requests for product inquiries. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/57389825265945) ##### 5️⃣ View Constraints * Click the View Constraints menu at the right bottom. * Turn on the “Custom View Constraints” option in the View Constraints menu. * Set the Horizontal Rotation, Vertical Rotation, and Default FOV values to limit the viewer’s camera movement and zoom range. * As shown in the guide at the bottom left, you can control the horizontal view range, vertical view range, and zoom level for the Live Showroom viewer. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/57833567768345)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/57833600390041)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/57833567774361) ### 3\. Virtual Showroom Live * Once you're done setting up the Virtual Showroom, click on the ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777909210777) to publish it. Once your Virtual Showroom is published, you may share the URL to your customers. * Click ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777898590489) to save any edits. This will not be reflected on your live Showroom. * Click ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777909525529) to test the Virtual Showroom before publishing it to live. * When you select a product and click **Add to Selection** , it will be added to your **My Selection** list. Click the **My Selection** list at the bottom right to review the selected items. Then, click **Inquiry about Selected Items** to submit your request, which will be sent via email. You may view your 3D Contents in CLO-SET 3D Viewer after it's been published. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/57833600398105) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/57389797313945)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/57389825274137)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/57389797315737) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/57389797316633)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/57389797317145) ### 4)Download Preset Image You may download the preset 360° background image by following the link. <https://drive.google.com/file/d/19ah3pr5RkbGthRiY3sdyWm2yDUh1eIYt/view?usp=sharing> ![Screenshot 2023-09-12 at 4.25.53 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777891625625) ### 5)Virtual Showroom Webinar * Learn how to setup the Virtual Showroom in CLO-SET. Find a local language session on [**CLO-SET YouTube**](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL8MWMK6wOJCm3wTyfESanrwpjKUyGT2zN). [![Video Frame.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777906611481)](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303177721113)
content_description: Create and customize your own 360° Virtual Showroom to showcase your products online, engage customers, and enhance their shopping experience.

title: CLOFAB in CLO-SET
content: # **Objective** ### Understand how to use **CLOFAB** in CLO-SET. 1. ##### What is CLOFAB? 2. ##### Open CLOFAB 3. ##### Generate Seamless Map 4. ##### Generate Drape 5. ##### Upload Fabric #### # **Details** ### 1) What is CLOFAB? CLOFAB is a fabric digitization tool that works with the AI-powered CLO zFab Kit, allowing you to create and register digital fabric assets without installing any separate software. Digitize fabrics quickly and precisely with CLOFAB in CLO-SET! Start building your fabric data with ease, save it directly to CLO-SET, and share it instantly with your team! Experience a faster, more efficient 3D workflow through the synergy of the zFab Kit and CLOFAB web. YouTube Video: https://youtube.com/watch?si=bBPKtCA7W_SAIhAw&v=v8oAOIiR7fg&feature=youtu.be **![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/60229960889881)** **Benefits of Integrating the zFab Kit** * **Superior Accuracy: User-Friendly with a Reduced Error Rate** The CLO zFab Kit dramatically cuts down errors during manual measurements. The system allows for streamlined cutting and analysis of the fabric's physical qualities, ensuring digital versions in CLO are precise and reliable for use in design and production. * **Enhanced Automation: Powered by CLO AI** Powered by CLO AI technology, the zFab Kit utilizes CLO's vast amounts of fabric data to automate the digitization process, significantly increasing speed, efficiency and accuracy for users. * **Seamless Integration: Work Effortlessly Within CLO's Ecosystem** The CLO zFab Kit is designed to work effortlessly with CLO’s existing suite of 3D design products and services, making it a breeze to work with high-quality digital fabric files within and beyond the CLO ecosystem. [**Order zFab Kit Now**](https://zfabkit.clo3d.com/) ### 2) Open CLOFAB 1. From your dashboard, click ![Button.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/60232238227993) button in the bottom-left corner to create a new fabric. Or, follow the steps below to open CLOFAB from a Workroom or Company Library. The fabric you create will be uploaded directly to that Workroom or Company Library. 2. Go to the **Workroom** or **Company Library**. 3. Click '**\+ NEW** ' button at the top left corner. Select **Create New Fabric** option from the drop-down list. ### 3) Generate Seamless Map Use an existing image to generate a seamless map. Alternatively, use the CLO zFab Scanner to capture high-resolution texture maps from physical fabric samples. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/60238599476761) ![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/60229960889881) * **Open Maps** 1. Click the ![Open Maps.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/60232243895961) button to open your map images. * Be sure to select all corresponding PBR maps at once. ![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/60229960889881) * **Auto Tiling** CLOFAB’s Auto Tiling uses pattern recognition to instantly create seamless repeating fabric maps. 1. Click and drag on the map image to define a repeat section. → The CLOFAB automatically analyzes the selected area, identifies the optimal repeat region, displays it as a grid, and previews the seamless repeating result. **✨Tip:** Auto Tiling works best **when your selection includes about four repeats** , providing the best balance between accuracy and speed. ![Repeat12.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/60230005834649) 2. By default, the pattern type is automatically set based on the map characteristics, but you can change it manually if needed. * Pattern Type is available only in Auto mode. **Pattern Type** | **Description** ---|--- **Plain/Irregular** | Fabrics with a single solid color of fabrics with irregularly scattered patterns.![Plain.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/60229960893721) **📝Note:** This option analyzes the fabric using the normal map and only works when a normal map is included. **Repeat** | Fabrics with evenly repeating patterns. ![Repeat.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/60229960894233) ![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/60229960889881) * **Manual Tiling** When you want to specify an area manually, switch to Manual Mode and adjust it directly. 1. In the Settings panel, toggle Auto Mode off. 2. Click and drag to define a repeat section. * You can refine it by dragging the corner or edge points to freely shape it into a polygon. → The selected area is repeated as is. ![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/60229960889881) * **Post-processing** 1. If the tiled fabric looks uneven in brightness, adjust it with the **Equalize** option in the Settings panel. ![Equalize.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/60230005836185) ### 4) Generarte Drape Simply enter your Fabric Type, Composition and Density to quickly create new accurate fabrics *After generating the map, it will also appear in the Physical Property preview, allowing you to review both the map and its physical properties at the same time. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/60238599478681) ![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/60229960889881) * **Create** 1. Click the **Physical Property** tab. 2. Select a fabric type. 3. Select the composition and enter the value (%). * Basic refers to the primary composition used for the selected fabric type, while Additional refers to compositions that can be combined as extras. 4. Enter the Weight and Thickness, and Click ![Compute.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/60234495173273) button. → The fabric is draped based on the entered values and previewed. 5. You can check and adjust each physical property value directly in the **Advanced Details** at the bottom if needed. ![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/60229960889881) * **Set Options** 1. **![WASM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/60234495175065)** Toggle to switch between model types. ### 5) Upload Fabric Upload the created maps and physical properties as a fabric file directly to CLO-SET, and share it instantly with your team! 1. Click ![Upload.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/60233547783833)button at the top right of CLOFAB. 2. Enter the fabric information, such as Fabric Name, Supplier, and Owner, then click the **Go to CLO-SET** button. 3. Select the file(s) to upload, and confirm the list and options. Click**UPLOAD** button. 4. Select a workroom to upload the fabric file, and click the Next button.
content_description: This web page aims to provide a comprehensive guide on utilizing CLOFAB within CLO-SET for efficient fabric digitization and management.

title: Input Data & Labels
content:
# **📝 List of Contents** 📍CLO-SET provides multiple options to help with the data management, including Category, Workflow, Tag, and Content Fields. Such fields are reflected on[ Web Tech Pack](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303168383385) and[ Line Sheet,](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303220619289) and can be utilized when [Searching](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303232416793) Contents. > _**Data & Labels on the Content Page**_
> > * In **Legacy** **Content** Page![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54984769820441)
> > 1\. Workflow
> > 2\. Category
> > 3\. Tags
> > 4\. Description
> > 5\. Content Field Management (by clicking More Information)
> > * In **New** **Content** Page
> > Within the **Overview section** , you can quickly review the following 5 key information:
> > ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56494297496729)

> > ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56494297497625) > > > **• Category, Workflow** --- * Enter [Dashboard](https://www.style.clo-set.com/), and click the Content to open the Content page. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54984764817049) * Enter the Content Page. You may assign a [Category](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303202913049) & [Workflow](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303233641241) to each Content > * In **Legacy** **Content** Page

> > **Workflow** : note which step the Content is on, in terms of the entire workflow
> > > > ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778119912473)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778135833241)
> > Assign **Workflow** from the drop-down menu. > > Click 'Edit' icon next to the **Category,** and select the attribute from the modal. Click OK to save
> > * In **New** **Content** Page
> > **Category** : note the attributes of the Content such as Fabric, Trims, Avatars, and Garment types (Category field in General Information)
> > **Workflow** : note which step the Content is on, in terms of the entire workflow (Workflow status bar on the top)
> > ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56494297496729)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56494297497881)
> > * **Bulk-assign** Category and Workflow from your Workroom. Start by selecting multiple Contents and click on Workflow or Category from the toolbar. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778136381081) * Both fields are **customizable** in [Company Settings](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303214894873) tab. | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778092913049) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778136840089) ---|---|--- * [Searching](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303232416793) is also available by Category or Workflow **• Tag, Description** --- | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778093315097)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56494297498265) | * **Tags** : save the keywords in hashtag form. Content Type in Web Tech Pack (BOM) # **Details** ### 1) Content Type Every Content is classified as a single Content Type in CLO-SET. At the time of upload, you may select the Content Type. Or, for specific file formats, CLO-SET will automatically assign a Content Type. *Any zprj/zpac files uploaded will automatically be identified as a Style Content Type. ![mceclip0.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778370822937)![Table \(1\) copy.jpg](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778335640729) #### > Note💡 : To use BOM and POM features for image files and other non-CLO assets on the Content Page, select **Style** in the Content Type selection modal when uploading the content.
> > ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/59283075344409) ### ### 2) Content ID Content ID is a unique ID auto-assigned by CLO-SET upon file upload. [New Content Page] | [Legacy Content Page] ---|--- ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56807361361561) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/55006044921369) * Content created on or after April 9th, 2024 * Content ID is made up of **6 digit number**. Each Group will have Content IDs starting from 000001. * Content created before April 9th, 2024 * Content ID is made up of **3 letter Prefix** (Content Type) **\+ 6 digit number**. Each Group will have Content IDs starting from 000001. * Prefix List: ![mceclip2.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778371347353) ### 3) Content Type in Web Tech Pack (BOM) You may add Fabric/Graphic/Trim information on [Web Tech Pack](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303168383385) \- BOM tab. Please note that the file format needs to match the Content Type to be added on BOM. ![Screenshot 2023-07-28 at 2.44.59 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778336186777)

title: Terms & Interface
content:
# **📝 List of Contents** 📍 New to CLO-SET? We've got you. Scroll to learn the terms & tricks before diving in to CLO-SET. * Terms * Tree Menu * Dashboard * Content Page (Overview / Viewer / BOM &POM / Cost Estimation / Attachment / Content Analysis) # **📓 Details** ## **1\. Terms** **▶** Group (![group.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776252644761))**:** Highest space level in CLO-SET. Each user owns 1 Group (ex. A's Group) **▶** Workroom (![workroom.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776220467097))**:** Where you upload your files. Consider this a 'folder' **▶** Content (![content.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776235598105))**:** Created whenever you upload a new file. You may upload any file format (not just 3D files) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776269142169) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776253480985) ---|--- ## ## **2\. Tree Menu** CLO-SET provides a pre-made space structure for easier asset management. * In each Group, there is Company ▶ Brand ▶ Line ▶ Season ▶ Workroom / Assortment ▶ Content * **Workroom**(![workroom.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776220467097)) is where you can upload your Contents * Click 'Browse' at the left to expand the tree menu to find the space you're looking for ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776269142169) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/55000901644569) ---|--- ## **3\. Dashboard** ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54868579650841) * **Menu Pane****:** Navigate between spaces, manage settings, and search Contents. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776269728281) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776269920409) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776221571097) ---|---|--- * **Contents List** : Easily spot the recents Contents visited, or those with latest updated. (recent content / updated content) * **Workrooms List** : Your go-to Workrooms listed. (favorite workroom / all workroom) * **Profile & Notification**: Manage account settings and notifications. _**💡 Notes**_ > Notification Tabs : **All, Comments, Updates, Account & Billing**![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54189220286489)**Notification Types**
> > **1\. Comments** : user comments and annotations
> > \- comment, comment_delete, annotation, annotation_delete, CONNECT marketplace_feedback, CONNECT marketplace_request.
> > **2\. Updates** : work and content-related updates
> > \- upload, render, fitting convert, configurator, web techpack, visual board, move, copy, delete, workroom, state, score, share
> > **3\. Account & Billing**: account, access, and billing notices
> > \- member, news, card, connect_purchase ## ## **4\. Content Page** In the left menu pane, follow these steps: 1. Double-click the **Workroom** in the Season space and Double-click the **Content** in the Workroom. 2. You can find detailed information in the**Content Page.** ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54870706694425)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54870706696089) ### **[New****Content page UI - Updated on Mar 31, 2026]** The new Content Page provides a unified content page experience. Key features such as Overview, Viewer, BOM, and Attachment will be organized into tabs, allowing you to perform design, analysis, and visualization tasks within a single page—without switching between screens. **![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489036252313)** #### **4-1) Overview** On the **Overview tab** , which is the main entry of the Content Page, you can view key information about the content at a glance. The Overview tab is structured into the following sections: **Overview, Details, Version, Linked Content, and 3D Quality Check**. Within the **Overview section** , you can quickly review the following 5 key information:![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489036259353) **1) Thumbnail Image & Content Field** \- Workflow Status, Score, Content ID, External No. External ID, Content type, Creator, Create Date **2) General** \- Material composition, Customer Type, Color, Price, MOQ, Category, Tag, Description **3) File Version** \- Total Version, Recent Version **4) Linked Content** \- Parent Content, Child Content **5) Setting** \- You can freely configure and customize the content information displayed in the Overview section. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489051549721) More detailed information about the content can be accessed by clicking the **Details, Version, Linked Content,** and**3D Quality Check** tabs.![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489036264985) #### **4-2) Viewer** In the **Viewer tab** , you can closely examine content in both 2D and 3D, and utilize various features to support review during the design development process. The following features are available in the Viewer tab: ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489036266265) ##### **1) Viewer Type (2D / 3D / Image / Render Viewer) & Viewing Option** \- Different viewer types and viewing options are provided to support content review from multiple perspectives. 1-1) 3D Viewer : Select a 3D file to freely explore and review garment data in the Viewer. 2D Pattern Viewer : View garment pattern data in a 2D format. Image Viewer : Check thumbnail images. Render Viewer : View rendered images. 1-2) Viewing Option : Use **Viewing Options** to explore content in various view modes. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489051570073) > _**💡**_ Note : View Control (Mouse Navigation)
> > **Mouse / Keyboard** | | **3D Viewer** > ---|---|--- > Roll up/down the Cursor | **![Scroll.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489036269337)**| Zoom in / Zoom out > Hold down the cursor wheel and drag | ![Mouse \(1\).png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489036270105) | Pan 3D View > Hold down the right click and drag | ![right click and rotate.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489036271129) | Rotate 3D View > Number keys | 🔢 | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489036271769) > > * #### **Mac Navigation**
> > > > For details on Mac Navigation, please find the[ attached PDF file](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489152977945). ##### **2) Upload (Version upload)** \- Files can be uploaded on the Content Page to manage versions. File information for each version is available for viewing and download. The following actions are supported: \- version upload \- check version list \- download \- techpack \- rename \- delete ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489036272537) ##### **3) Render** \- Rendering functionality is supported to enable more realistic results. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489036273305) ##### **4) Comment** \- The Comment feature has been expanded to the content level, allowing comments to be added while reviewing different tabs. Comments can be added to content for communication. Individual users or [Teams](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303212732441) can be tagged using **@** (e.g., @clovirtualfashion). An activity log is also available for review. (_Note: The activity log is only accessible to users with Editor-level permissions or higher._) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489051594777) ##### **5) Share** \- Content can be shared by entering an email address. Enter the email address, select a permission (**Editor** or **Viewer**), and click **Share**. The email address does not need to be registered in CLO-SET. \- Users with access to the content can be viewed in the **People with access** section. > _**💡 Notes :**_ The visibility of this option may vary depending on Company Settings.
> > Permission approval can be configured in the Console under **Permission Approval** settings. > If enabled, invitations require approval from a Group Admin before access is granted. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489036275097) ##### **6) Open in CLO** \- Content can be opened in CLO for design modifications. **![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489051604377)** ##### **7) Annotation (Create Annotation / Annotation List)** 7-1) Create Annotation : Annotations can be created to provide precise feedback for garment modifications. **\- View Point Setting Before Creating an Annotation** Before creating an annotation, you can first set the desired viewpoint. This allows feedback to be captured based on the exact screen state and context, improving clarity and accuracy during the review process. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489051614617) **\- Add New Marker** A new **Add New Marker** function has been introduced, allowing you to add markers continuously while creating annotations. Multiple annotations can be created without interrupting your workflow, enabling a more seamless review experience. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489036287897) **\- Improved Drawing & Editing Tools** The toolbar has been repositioned to the top, ensuring it does not obstruct the Viewer. Additionally, **Text** and **Pen tools** are now supported to provide a more advanced editing experience. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489051617561) 7-2) Annotation List : View all annotations for the content. **\- Replies and Nested Replies Visible in the Annotation Pane** Both replies and nested replies are now visible within the Annotation Panel. This makes it easier to follow conversation threads in one place and better understand feedback history and collaboration context. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56493349549977) ##### **8) Configurator** \- The **Configurator** is provided in a new window. After adding a colorway in the Configurator and saving, refresh the original tab to view the newly added colorway. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489051618585) ##### **9) Colorway List** \- In the Colorway List, colorway information can be reviewed and the colorway status can be updated. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489051619609) ##### **10) Settings / Full Screen** \- Viewer settings—including features such as **Embed View,** **Screenshot, Change Thumbnail**(thumbnail displayed in the Workroom view and the Overview tab of the Content Page)**** and**Download** —along with a full-screen view option are available in the bottom-right corner of the Viewer. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/57710098417561) #### **4-3) BOM / POM** BOM and POM information for garment content can be viewed directly on the Content Page without navigating to a separate page. Even without a 3D file, BOM and POM can be created and managed as drafts. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489036295065)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489051622169) #### **4-4) Cost Estimation** Cost estimation information for garment content can be viewed directly on the Content Page without navigating to a separate page. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489036299033) #### **4-5) Attachment** The Content Page supports attaching various files for the design development process. Files such as images and PDFs can be uploaded using the **Upload File** button in the top-right corner or via drag and drop. You can also click **Add Link** to include reference URLs along with descriptions. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489051624345)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489036303001) #### **4-6) Content Analysis** In **Content Analysis** tab, workflow analysis and activity analysis data of the content can be reviewed. \- **Workflow Analysis Chart** : provides an overview of workflow status changes and lead times for each process step, allowing key metrics to be understood at a glance. \- **Activity Analysis Chart** : visualizes trends in key activity metrics over time using bubble and stacked charts, providing actionable insights. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489051625625) > _**💡 Notes :**_ To use the previous UI (_Legacy Content Page UI_) , click the **Previous Layout** button at the top of the Content Page.
> > To switch back to the new UI, click **Try New Layout** at the top of the Legacy Content Page.
> > The legacy UI will remain available alongside the new experience for a period of time following the March 31, 2026 update.
> > ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489036306841)
> > ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489036307481) > _**💡 Notes :**_ If you frequently work in another tab — such as **Viewer, BOM, POM, or Cost Estimation** — you can set your preferred tab as your **default tab** for faster access.
> > 1. Open the tab you would like to set as your default.
> 2. Once the tab is selected, click the **More Options menu (⋮)** next to the tab name.
> 3. Select **Set as default tab**.
> ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/58290448884249)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/58290448885657)
> > After setting it, your selected tab will automatically open first whenever you enter the Content Page.
> > If you would like to remove the setting, open the same menu and select **Unset default tab**.
> > ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/58290448886169) ### ### ##
